data.title: RDKit Molecular Similarity Search
data.description: Rank only your supplied CSV collection (up to 10,000 rows / 2 MiB) using Morgan radius 2, 2048 bits, chirality enabled and Tanimoto similarity. Public original 13-row example: 11 valid, 2 invalid; raising threshold 0.2 to 0.6 reduces hits from 6 to 3. Drawings, exact scores and CSV/JSON downloads. Structural similarity does not establish activity or safety. Public hosting is prepared and awaiting its exact approval and administrator review; examples and downloads are public.
